_comment: Intentional differences between contracts/openapi.json and web/src/app/core/api/api-types.ts. Every entry needs a reason. Keys: ignoredSchemas (schema name -> reason), aliases (schema name -> TS name), ignoredProperties ('Schema.property' -> reason).

ignoredSchemas.IFormFile: Multipart upload placeholder; the web client sends FormData, not a typed body.
ignoredSchemas.ReaderMode: The spec models the enum as an integer; the client uses the string-union form ('PagedLtr' ...) the server's JSON converter emits. Value sets are not compared.
ignoredSchemas.BackupLocationUpdate: The client types this inline as UpdateBackupSettingsRequest.location instead of a named interface.
ignoredSchemas.SetReaderModeRequest: The client sends { readerMode } inline from api.service.ts; no named type exists.

ignoredProperties.YacReaderImportRequest.yacDbPath: Deliberately absent: the server detects the YACReader database itself, so the client never sends a path (no-paths-over-the-wire rule).
ignoredProperties.UpdateBackupSettingsRequest.location: Inline object type on the client (see BackupLocationUpdate above); the spec models it as a nullable $ref.
